# Technology logo sources

SVG brand silhouettes are stored locally. Background tiles were removed from Skill Icons assets and SVG paint normalized to currentColor for the portfolio palette; shapes are retained.

- Devicon Plain (MIT), via https://github.com/iconify/icon-sets/blob/master/json/devicon-plain.json: Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, PostgreSQL, Python, Git, Figma, Photoshop, Claude, Codex.
- Skill Icons (MIT), via https://github.com/iconify/icon-sets/blob/master/json/skill-icons.json: React, GitHub.
- VSCode Icons (MIT), via https://github.com/iconify/icon-sets/blob/master/json/vscode-icons.json: Tailwind CSS.
- CoreUI Brands (CC0-1.0), via https://github.com/iconify/icon-sets/blob/master/json/cib.json: Canva.
- shadcn/ui (MIT), https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/components/icons.tsx: shadcn/ui.

Brand names and logos belong to their respective owners.
